title: Design System: MISE BY MiseLink

display.purpose: Inherited MISE BY display headings via font-display.

utility.purpose: URLs and numeric destination order via font-mono.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Mar Digital navy #0A2540 with white text, used for primary actions.

components.name: Destination Card
components.description: White, slate-200 outline, navy text, restrained radius, and existing reorder controls.

components.name: Public Order Pixel
components.description: Square navy marker with a zero-padded index for active public links; collections and inactive rows show a dash.

components.name: Pixel Reticula
components.description: Low-opacity Tailwind reticula derived from the existing MISE BY grid motif, shown subtly over white editor canvases.

components.name: Live Preview
components.description: Sticky desktop preview and existing mobile preview dialog; public-page theme remains unchanged.

overview: MiseLink uses the Mar Digital palette: exact brand navy #0A2540 and white #FFFFFF, with slate neutrals. A subtle navy pixel reticula and square status marks express the pixel system. Geist typography and the shared dashboard shell are preserved. The editor is responsive and does not change public rendering or data behavior.
principles: Use only #0A2540 and #FFFFFF as the defined Mar Digital principal colors.
Use navy #0A2540 for primary actions, selected states, status, and focus; use white and slate neutrals for surfaces.
Use the low-opacity Tailwind reticula derived from the existing MISE BY grid motif; do not add global CSS.
Keep labels, controls, and spacing clear, balanced, and responsive.
Preserve profile, destination, ordering, preview, publication, and sharing functionality.
